Walk the ruined road of Aurelion

WASD move · Shift sprint · Space dodge roll (first 0.4 s is invulnerable) · F jump · Left click combo · Right click heavy · E interact · R ash of war · X switch ash · Q potion (also cures poison)
C dive · G fish · H open the glider while high above the ground (cliffs, towers, castle walls), H or Y to fold it; it drains stamina very slowly; steer with A/D, Shift to dive faster (watch the fish below the surface) · I inventory · M map (click a resting place to fast-travel, click elsewhere for a waypoint) · J journal · L achievements
U Magic menu (attune spells; Shift+1-9 cast a slot) · O Settings (keys, volume, brightness, render distance) · Level up and swear oaths at a Resting Place · Bosses grant extra potions · B cast · N switch spell (needs Staff/Seal) · V summon spirit · T switch spirit · Dungeons: find arches/purple triangles on the map, E to enter
Time passes: the tide rises and falls with the day, and a Leviathan stirs at high tide. Beware bleeding and poison. Every launch draws a new world.
